name: rius
description: Codex plugin (beta) that streams your sessions to Rius as OpenTelemetry traces: prompts, model calls, tokens, tool calls and subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Track Codex usage and cost in Rius
interface.longDescription: Streams each Codex session to Rius as one OpenTelemetry GenAI trace: turns, model calls with token counts, tool calls and subagents. Rius prices the tokens, so you see cost per session and per developer. Tracing is off until you enable a folder, and sends structure only by default; prompt and tool output capture is optional.
